mapper.sql: ID, DEVICE_CODE, DEVICE_NAME, TOURISM_NAME, COUNT, DENSITY, RECORD_TIME, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME
mapper.select:
SELECT /*+ INDEX(CROWD_STATISTICS IDX_CROWD_RECORD_TIME) */
FROM CLOUDWALK.CROWD_STATISTICS
ORDER BY RECORD_TIME DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT CASE WHEN DENSITY <= 0.2 THEN '0-0.2' WHEN DENSITY <= 0.4 THEN '0.2-0.4' WHEN DENSITY <= 0.6 THEN '0.4-0.6' WHEN DENSITY <= 0.8 THEN '0.6-0.8' ELSE '0.8-1.0' END as density_range, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(AVG(COUNT), 2) as avg_count, ROUND(AVG(DENSITY), 4) as avg_density FROM CLOUDWALK.CROWD_STATISTICS
GROUP BY density_range ORDER BY density_range

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT <= 10 THEN '0-10' WHEN COUNT <= 30 THEN '10-30' WHEN COUNT <= 50 THEN '30-50' WHEN COUNT <= 100 THEN '50-100' ELSE '100+' END as count_range, COUNT(*) as count, ROUND(AVG(DENSITY), 4) as avg_density FROM CLOUDWALK.CROWD_STATISTICS
GROUP BY count_range ORDER BY count_range

SELECT TO_CHAR(RECORD_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:00:00') as time_slot, ROUND(AVG(COUNT), 2) as avg_count, ROUND(AVG(DENSITY), 4) as avg_density, MAX(COUNT) as max_count, MIN(COUNT) as min_count FROM CLOUDWALK.CROWD_STATISTICS
GROUP BY TO_CHAR(RECORD_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:00:00') ORDER BY time_slot

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_records, COUNT(DISTINCT DEVICE_CODE) as device_count, ROUND(AVG(DENSITY), 4) as avg_density, MAX(DENSITY) as max_density, MIN(DENSITY) as min_density, ROUND(AVG(COUNT), 2) as avg_count, MAX(COUNT) as max_count, MIN(COUNT) as min_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN DENSITY >= 0.8 THEN 1 END) as high_density_count FROM CLOUDWALK.CROWD_STATISTICS

SELECT /*+ INDEX(CROWD_STATISTICS IDX_CROWD_DENSITY) */ DEVICE_CODE, DEVICE_NAME, COUNT(*) as occurrences, ROUND(AVG(DENSITY), 4) as avg_density, MAX(DENSITY) as max_density, MIN(DENSITY) as min_density, ROUND(AVG(COUNT), 2) as avg_count, MAX(COUNT) as max_count FROM CLOUDWALK.CROWD_STATISTICS
GROUP BY DEVICE_CODE, DEVICE_NAME ORDER BY avg_density DESC
FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT
FROM CLOUDWALK.CROWD_STATISTICS WHERE DEVICE_CODE = #{deviceCode} ORDER BY RECORD_TIME DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
